name: contact
title: Contact form
description: Contact page and form with layered spam protection (honeypot, timing, rate limit, optional Turnstile) and email delivery.

env.name: CONTACT_TO_EMAIL
env.description: Inbox that receives contact form submissions

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY
env.description: Cloudflare Turnstile site key. Set both Turnstile keys to add an invisible challenge

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.description: Questions, ideas or feedback. We read every message and reply by email.
contact.successMessage: Thanks! Your message is on its way. We'll get back to you by email.

postInstall: Set CONTACT_TO_EMAIL to the inbox that should receive messages.
Page copy lives in site.config.ts under `contact`.
Optional: add Cloudflare Turnstile keys for an invisible bot challenge.
